decisions.reason: Strong visible adoption by a major public customer and over 30 government APIS schemes suggests uncertainty has largely resolved positively, and this scalable digital offer fits the firm's expanding integrated travel-security portfolio.

Although the website shows no hard performance evidence yet, it remained actively marketed through 2024, complements the firm's airport and travel compliance services, and is relatively cheap to keep as an option while demand continues to develop.

Its survival on a dedicated page through 2024 indicates enough commercial promise to retain it, and as a document-verification platform it supports the firm's core customer base and is worth keeping open while market learning continues.
